question.question:
A project has three scenarios. Base-case value: 79.5 USD million. Upside value: base raised by 35 percent. Downside value: base lowered by 10 percent, then less a one-time remediation charge of 2.5 USD million incurred only in the downside scenario. Probabilities in percent: upside 25, downside 50, base case the remainder so they sum to 100; the base probability must be strictly positive or the valuation is invalid. Compute the probability-weighted expected value, the base-case probability, and the downside loss versus base as a positive magnitude (base value minus downside value). Report as the final answer the incremental expected value versus base, i.e. expected value minus base value, keeping its sign, in USD million.

Answer format: return only the exact numeric value interpreted in `usd_million`, using finite-decimal notation when it terminates in base 10 and an irreducible `numerator/denominator` fraction otherwise, with no unit label or additional text.

slots.description: Base-case probability in percent after assigning the remainder
Probability-weighted expected project value across the three scenarios
Base value minus downside value, reported as positive magnitude
